overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the emails with a member of the public were not deliberation by a quorum, and a two-member private exchange is below quorum.

allegations.summary: A quorum of the board allegedly deliberated by email about a notice topic (veterans parking) outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because the communications were between only one Commission member and a member of the public, who is not subject to the Open Meeting Law, such communications did not constitute deliberation.

allegations.summary: Two board members allegedly privately discussed the complainant's emails outside an open meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because that communication was between two members of the Board, which is not a quorum, it did not constitute deliberation outside of a posted meeting and did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
